baseline.worktree: Already contained uncommitted passes 09-10; not clean-release acceptance
baseline.publication: No version change, commit, tag, push or deployment.

scope.meaning: HTTP mark-read/deletion through owner admission, persistence barrier, SQL and local publication; honest acknowledgement, cancellation/deadlines, repair and cold-cache counts.
scope.boundaries: Actual Axum router with synthetic sessions and EventBus injected with private Unix-socket PostgreSQL 16.15. DATABASE_URL unset; no deployment services or real events used.
excluded: new routes/access tiers/Event/database schema/SDK signature or frontend product source changes

findings.summary: Failed mark-read/delete SQL, failed publication barriers and prior latched fallback returned HTTP success without confirmed storage mutation.
findings.fix: New fallible HTTP helpers reject configured unavailable/invalid or latched storage and failed barriers with generic no-store 503. Definite schema/query errors preserve memory and remain retryable; no volatile success fallback. Legacy public helper contracts remain.

findings.summary: An SQL mutation blocked publishing local cache did not complete within a 12-second test bound.
findings.fix: Ten-second cooperative caller wait includes owner admission. Admitted SQL worker retains owner ordering through local publication even after cancellation/timeout; an unconfirmed response is not rollback.

findings.summary: Successful mutation responses lacked no-store; deletion extraction had a separate plain-text error path.
findings.fix: Success and handler failures are no-store; deletion extraction/validation are generic JSON 400. Initial red asserted missing success header; final test expands both mutation responses and invalid/unknown/duplicate queries.

expanded_postgres.note: Before final additional cold-cache SQL case; same runtime implementation.

tdd.after_red_guards: Three ordinary service guards and four further PostgreSQL cases added after initial failure reproductions. Memory capacity-cache atomicity is protective coverage, not a separate reproduced pre-fix defect.

operational_diagnostic.meaning: Mistyped checker path; not a product/test defect. Correct checker rerun separately.

quality_gate.compatibility: OpenAPI/API/SDK generation and surface checks passed at unchanged version 0.4.0; 64 paths, 68 Engine operations, 63 SDK operations, 85 schemas
quality_gate.note: Tool/SSH/kernel-smoke checks are isolated fixtures, not privileged deployment acceptance.

post_documentation_preflight.meaning: Final bilingual report/course mirrors and common contracts, file length/version/formatter/tool checks; runtime unchanged from full gate.

earlier_narrow_default.note: Narrower module selection before final cold-cache guard; not a different pass total.

event_postgres.command: env -u DATABASE_URL CYANREX_DB_FALLBACK=true CYANREX_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<explicit disposable private socket URL> cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --locked --lib services::event_bus::tests -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
event_postgres.note: Includes post-commit timeout completion, admitted cancellation/order, cold deletion counts/read flags and SQL timeout without claiming server rollback.

contract_ci.note: 41 exact ordering-job selections plus existing separately selected deletion cover all 42 event PostgreSQL cases; nonempty guards retained.

preservation.note: Original inventory and historical pass 01-10 documents/reports/logs/mirrors remain byte-identical, including uncommitted passes 09-10 and captured whitespace.

limitations: Unconfirmed is not rollback: dispatched SQL or local publication may finish after caller cancellation/timeout or lost response. No automatic retry; verify state first.
Ten seconds bounds cooperative service waiting, not auth, serialization, CPU stalls, server-side SQL cancellation or entire worker lifetime; admitted workers can wait for cache locks.
Definite query/schema errors can be retried, but barrier/storage deadlines and independent writer failures can still latch existing fallback until repair/restart without volatile reconciliation.
No process shutdown hook, crash/power-loss recovery, network partition/lost-commit fault injection, durable replay or exactly-once guarantee.
Ordering covers one EventBus and its clones, not external SQL writers or multiple Engines.
Legacy infallible mutation helpers and settings/publication fallback retain their compatibility contracts; explicit memory-only HTTP success remains volatile.
Frontend source unchanged; existing frontend tests are not a new live browser-to-Engine integration run.
